title: Requests and instructions
summary: Use the imperative of the exact lemma for the indicated person. Do not add particles.

write-you.sentenceGloss: Olena, write the telephone number here.

copy-we.sentenceGloss: Let us copy the unfamiliar words into a separate list.

check-plural.sentenceGloss: Dear readers, check the page number.

sit-plural.sentenceGloss: Dear guests, sit down by the window.

throw-you.sentenceGloss: Taras, throw the ball into the basket.

fill-plural.sentenceGloss: Dear participants, fill in the questionnaire before the meeting.
